item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera stands in front of a plane mirror hanging on the wall of her bedroom at home in Jaipur and looks at her image.
Which set of properties correctly describes the image formed in the plane mirror?

options.A: The image is upright, the same size as Meera, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
options.B: The image is upside down, smaller than Meera, appears on the mirror surface, and can be obtained on a screen.
options.C: The image is upright, larger than Meera, appears in front of the mirror, and can be obtained on a screen.
options.D: The image is upside down, the same size as Meera, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
